claims.statement: EU guidance defines energy performance contracting as a monitored arrangement in which investments are paid in relation to an agreed energy-efficiency improvement or financial savings.
The same guidance calls for clear provisions on measuring and verifying guaranteed savings, including milestones, reference dates, documented changes, quality checks, and guarantees.
The EU Data Act gives industrial-equipment users access to performance data that can support efficiency and operations services.

contrary_evidence: Energy performance contracting already uses established measurement and verification standards and specialist consultants.
Data access rights do not guarantee clean, real-time, or contractually admissible meter and operating data.

economics.acquisition_route: Co-design with one controls installer or ESCO on a small portfolio, then partner with energy auditors and equipment finance providers
economics.founder_net_worth_path: A plausible 5-7 year path would require approximately 800-1,200 active sites at around 9,000-12,000 PLN annual recurring revenue, partner-led acquisition, and founder ownership of the software and performance dataset
economics.founder_time: Approximately 12-16 hours per week with accredited energy and M&V specialists contracted for methodology approval
economics.gross_margin_basis: Analytics and billing software less meter connectors, data cleaning, specialist M&V review, and customer support
economics.payback: A site can justify the fee if transparent calculations accelerate invoice approval or avoid recurring specialist reconciliation; dispute frequency must be measured
economics.pricing: About 750-1,500 PLN per site per month plus 0.25-0.75% of accepted performance-linked payments
economics.retention_or_repeat: Performance contracts run for years and issue monthly receipts; contractors originate additional sites

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A cross-project library of baseline adjustments, exception frequency, and realised savings could make new contracts easier to price and finance
fingerprint.customer: Polish and Central European SME ESCOs, HVAC controls firms, industrial-efficiency contractors, and their building or factory clients
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Sell through energy auditors, controls installers, ESCO finance providers, and renovation one-stop shops
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Baseline versioning, adjustment models, exception approval, transparent calculation receipt, and accounting-system invoice instructions
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The ESCO or customer pays per monitored site plus a small share when a monthly savings amount is jointly accepted and invoiced
fingerprint.problem_trigger: An efficiency project is paid from measured savings but baseline changes, weather, occupancy, production, or equipment downtime make the invoice contestable

founder_fit: Causal baselines, time-series models, and transparent calculation receipts match the founder's data-science skills
Renewable-family relationships provide access to adjacent controls and energy-service firms
The model can start as software and specialist-assisted verification without financing equipment
risks: Baseline disputes may require experts rather than software
Bad models could generate incorrect invoices and liability
Building-management and M&V vendors may bundle this function
Long performance contracts can create slow onboarding and demanding support

structure.commercial_archetype: Shared-savings billing middleware charging per site and per verified payout
structure.control_point: The contract-bound, versioned baseline and jointly accepted monthly savings receipt that determines the performance-linked invoice
structure.critical_dependency: Both parties must accept the measurement and verification method and provide reliable meter and operating-condition data

thesis: Small ESCOs and contractors selling energy-efficiency upgrades on guaranteed-savings or shared-savings terms could use a neutral measurement, verification, and invoice-split engine. It would freeze the baseline and adjustment policy at contract signing, ingest meter and operating data, produce a jointly signed monthly savings receipt, and send approved invoice instructions to existing accounting and payment systems.
title: SavingsSplit Billing Engine
uncertainties: Number of SME performance contracts with unresolved monthly billing friction
Whether Polish counterparties accept an external M&V receipt
Which vertical has sufficiently standard adjustments for a narrow first product
